content:
![](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/07/Verge-RedditBrands_V1-Final.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Earlier this year, a Reddit user had [asked](https://www.reddit.com/r/SkincareAddicts/comments/1t9jvcf/magic_molecule_hypochlorous_acid_spray_is_it/) members of a skincare-focused subreddit if anyone had tried a specific hypochlorous acid spray, a product often used for acne. There were dozens of responses; one from a user named Primary-Taro4254 seemed innocuous enough, at least at first.

"I haven't personally tried \[that brand\] so I can't fully compare, sorry," they commented. "But I have been using a similar hypochlorous acid spray from Honeydew Labs and I've honestly really liked it."

Primary-Taro4254 helpfully shared their experience using the spray to calm their skin's redness and irritation, and even threw in some of Honeydew Labs' crede …

title: (No AI) Europe’s AI labeling and transparency rules are now in effect
author: Jess Weatherbed
content:
![AI labels designed by the European Commission.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/EU-AI-label-icons-hero.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

The EU made some AI labels that companies can use instead of designing their own. | Image: The European Commission / The Verge

The European Union has ushered in some additional rules that aim to make it easier for people to identify chatbots and AI deepfakes online. The [new transparency obligations](https://commission.europa.eu/news-and-media/news/safer-and-more-transparent-ai-2026-08-02_en) under the bloc's landmark AI Act came into effect [on August 2nd](https://ec.europa.eu/commission/presscorner/detail/en/ip_26_1714), requiring companies to disclose when people are interacting with AI models, and if content has been generated or altered by them.

The [transparency rules](https://ai-act-service-desk.ec.europa.eu/en/ai-act/article-50) differ between providers (companies that develop and market AI systems) and deployers (platforms and services that use those AI systems), though some companies like Meta and SpaceXAI are classified as both.

![AI labels designed by the EU, with some use case examples.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/Screenshot-2026-08-03-181006.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100 "AI labels designed by the EU, with some use case examples.")
